verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for a developer framework, but the evidence shows no Pipecat feature that takes natural-language commands to scaffold, deploy, or evaluate projects. The context-hub MCP server and generated AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md files only give an external coding agent docs and context; the natural-language layer belongs to that third-party agent, which makes this adjacent support only. The voice bots users build are conversational, but that is the end-product being built, not a way to operate Pipecat itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
